corrections.why: The NGS survey mark for this tower (FX4177, top of the cabin) is at 36 24 44.04909 N, 77 20 37.93467 W, about 120 m west of the record point. Proposed values are the NGS position in decimal degrees. For human review.

sources.title: NGS Data Sheet for survey mark FX4177, Jackson Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Record status and access are unknown and stay that way. The only dated history entry in the NGS datasheet is the 1959 observation, and no later source was found for the tower's condition. Two WebSearch queries found no other Jackson tower record. A street named Fire Tower Road lies near the Northampton County Forest Service office (1112 Fire Tower Road, Jackson); no source ties that name to this tower, so it is not used. height_m 33.5 is the metric conversion of the NGS overall height of 110 feet, not height to the cab floor. The correction moves the record point about 120 m west and 30 m south, to the NGS mark; for human review.
